mechanism: shared responsibility under asymmetric reputational risk
relationship_structure: two long-term collaborators whose friendship predates their joint community project
power_structure: one controls the public account and donor access; the other holds operational evidence and local trust
goal_conflict: a donor update is due in five days, but an unreported delivery failure makes the public success claim misleading
information_asymmetry: each person knows a different part of the failure and privately fears a different reputational loss
history_dependency: they previously agreed to disclose setbacks together after an earlier near-miss
one collaborator recently absorbed public blame to protect the other
a scheduled logistics review in two days can verify what happened but cannot decide how they disclose it

coverage_requirements.opening_condition: the environment agent asks to align the donor update before the verification meeting
coverage_requirements.choice_space: fact checking, bounded disclosure, delay with conditions, responsibility sharing, third-party facilitation
coverage_requirements.longitudinal_need: later trust judgments must depend on whether commitments made before the logistics review are kept
